baseline_brief: Use the original classic Ender-3 reference to make an electronics inspection-card pen plotter. Use a 10 mm cylindrical pen, a 100 by 80 mm drawing viewport, 180 by 180 mm paper, and a 3 mm pen lift. Draw a clean blank inspection record: one closed outer border; a header split into two empty fields; four evenly spaced checklist rows on the left, each with one empty square checkbox and a blank writing line; and one large clear rectangular board-sketch area on the right. Leave the fields blank for handwriting. Use only simple single-stroke outlines, no lettering or decorative symbols, with internal whitespace so lines do not overlap. Generate the actual drawing for this brief.
revision_brief: Keep exactly the same inspection-card artwork and the 3 mm pen lift. Change to a 12 mm diameter cylindrical pen. Use an A5 landscape sheet, 210 mm wide by 148 mm high, with a centered 190 by 128 mm drawing viewport and at least 10 mm margin on every edge. Preserve the existing drawing, changing only these numeric settings. Produce the revised digital build.
